display.purpose: Patient name and note title only. The one serif.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels and column headers.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Transient overlays only: popovers, dropdowns, command palette. Nothing persistent casts a shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-emphasis action. Dark fill, no hue; emphasis comes from darkness, not color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #211c17; color: #f9f6f2; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.006em; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5c5752; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f9f6f2, 0 0 0 4px #211c17; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and tertiary actions. Hairline border, fills to Chart on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #211c17; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #dbd7d1; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0ece7; border-color: #c2bdb7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f9f6f2, 0 0 0 4px #211c17; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Patient search. Hairline border, warm surface, Ink focus ring, no accent hue.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #f9f6f2; color: #211c17; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #dbd7d1; border-radius: 5px; width: 220px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6d6863; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #211c17; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #211c17; }

components.name: Note Field
components.description: The signature component. A structured note field at rest: uppercase label, Body value, hairline divider. Not boxed like a form input.
components.html: Chief complaintRight ankle pain after inversion injury, 2 days ago.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dbd7d1; max-width: 640px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c5752; } .ds-field-value { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #211c17; }

components.name: Caution Field
components.description: A low-confidence extraction. The one permitted colored left edge, because here the edge is clinical data. Color paired with a text label.
components.html:
DosageReview
Ibuprofen 600mg (inferred; not stated explicitly)
components.css: .ds-field-caution { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 12px 0 12px 12px; border-left: 2px solid #905500; max-width: 640px; } .ds-field-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c5752; } .ds-field-value { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; color: #211c17; } .ds-chip-caution { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #905500; background: #feedd7; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Verified Chip
components.description: Read-only status signal for a clinician-confirmed field. Surface + matching foreground, text carries the meaning.
components.css: .ds-chip-verified { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2e734b; background: #e0f5e6; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Allergy Alert
components.description: The loudest, rarest signal. Allergies and contraindications. Alert surface with an icon plus text; never color alone.
components.html: Allergy: Penicillin (anaphylaxis)
components.css: .ds-alert { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffe7e4; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 5px; max-width: 640px; } .ds-alert-text { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #211c17; } .ds-alert-text strong { color: #bc2826; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: A warm off-white paper chart rebuilt as fast software. The surface is quiet, warm, and achromatic; color is not decoration and never sets a mood; color is a clinical signal with a fixed vocabulary of three meanings. Dense the way a well-set page is dense, through typographic hierarchy and spacing rhythm, never through shrinking. It borrows Linear's discipline but not its palette or its dark chrome: light because a clinician reads it in a bright room, warm because cold grey is the color of the EHR it replaces.
keyCharacteristics: Light, warm, achromatic canvas; the only color is clinical meaning.
A serif for the patient's name and the note's identity; a sans for everything operational.
Density earned through hierarchy and rhythm, not compression.
Structure carried by hairline rules and tonal layers, not shadows or cards.
Every generated claim is visibly traceable back to what was said.

rules.name: The Clinical Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color appears on screen if and only if it carries one of three fixed meanings: Alert, Caution, Verified. No fourth color, no decorative use. A screen at rest is entirely warm-neutral; any hue is information.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is tinted toward hue 70-75. Pure #000, pure #fff, and any cold blue-grey are forbidden. Cold grey is the color of the incumbent EHR.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Sacred Rule
rules.body: Newsreader appears only for the patient's name and the note's title. Every additional serif dilutes the one signal it carries: this record is about a person.

rules.name: The Label-Is-Not-Loud Rule
rules.body: Field labels earn distinction through uppercase and letter-spacing at 11px in Graphite, not size or heavy weight. Labels recede; the clinical values are what the eye lands on.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Content is organized by tonal layer and hairline rule, not rounded floating cards with shadows. Use a Chart-toned region with a Rule border. Nested cards are always forbidden.

rules.name: The Shadow-Means-Temporary Rule
rules.body: If it casts a shadow, it must be dismissable and transient. Persistent structure never casts a shadow.

dos: Do keep the resting screen entirely warm-neutral. If you see a hue, it must mean Alert, Caution, or Verified.
Do tint every neutral toward hue 70-75. Warm, never cold.
Do layer with Chart-on-Bone and hairline Rules to create structure.
Do reserve Newsreader for the patient name and note title, nothing else.
Do edit fields in place with click-to-edit; keep the whole note visible while editing.
Do give every generated field a visible path back to its transcript source.
Do pair every color signal with a text or icon channel.
Do keep transitions at 150-250ms and reserve motion for genuine state changes.
donts: Don't use purple-to-blue gradients, glassmorphism, translucent floating cards, gradient text, or the hero-metric template. The current code commits this; delete it.
Don't reintroduce cold grey-on-grey chrome, native 1998 form controls, or unreadable compression.
Don't introduce a fourth accent color or use any semantic color decoratively.
Don't put content in rounded white cards with drop shadows on a grey field. Never nest cards.
Don't open a modal to view or edit a note field.
Don't use a colored border-left greater than 1px as decoration; the only exception is the 2px Caution/Alert field marker.
Don't signal confidence, recording state, or validation with color alone.
Don't animate layout properties or add page-load choreography.
